claim: A frozen episodic context and route boundary grows from two length-six capabilities to 100 capabilities across seven temporal shifts using isolated external state, selective fresh-outcome remediation, persistence, reversal-safe retention, and zero replay.
retention_on_mastered_primitives: All 100 rows were protected before reversal; full-bank eviction was refused, only the target row was released after four failures, and that row re-protected after fresh recovery outcomes. The frozen context/router state and earlier route/credit state were unchanged.
next_bottleneck: The boundary remains a bounded generated family bank; the next challenge is open-ended capability acquisition with learned blueprint/compression or genuine new computation, while preserving the same retention and no-replay guarantees.
